note: Keyed by recipe. A measurement is shown ONLY on the recipe it was taken on — the first version attached one chest X-ray result to every dual-arm recipe, which stated something no measurement supported for CIFAR-10.

PNEUMONIA_CNN.headline: On this recipe freezing costs 21.8 accuracy points and saves only 1.004x the communication — its classifier is 99.6% of the model, so there is almost nothing to freeze.

measured_on.backbone: PneumoniaCNN features.*, randomly initialised (identical for both arms)
measured_on.protocol: 3 rounds, 2 clients, alpha 0.5, 800 samples/split, seed 0, live federation on the product path

FULL.summary: Reaches 92.4% and was still improving at round 3. The only arm that learns on this recipe.

FROZEN_HEAD.summary: Reaches 70.6%, identical in every round — the majority-class rate, so it never learns. This recipe's classifier is 99.6% of its parameters, so freezing the rest saves almost no communication either.

caveats: 3 rounds, 2 clients, one seed, 800 samples per split. The FULL arm had not converged, so its number is a floor.
The frozen arm's accuracy equals the majority-class rate and is identical across all three rounds — that is no learning, not merely weak learning.
Communication is the server's per-download payload, not a full round-trip budget.

The research campaign's frozen arm on this task used a pretrained ResNet-18 feature extractor with a 1,026-parameter head and reached very different conclusions. It is a different architecture and its results are not shown here.

CNN.headline: On this recipe the frozen arm reaches 10.0% — chance level for ten classes. A full fine-tune reaches 38.0%.

measured_on.backbone: CnnNet, randomly initialised (identical for both arms)
measured_on.protocol: 3 rounds, 2 clients, seed 0, live federation on the product path

FULL.summary: Reaches 38.0% and is still improving at round 3. The only arm that learns on this recipe.

FROZEN_HEAD.summary: Reaches 10.0%, which is chance for ten classes. This recipe's backbone is randomly initialised, so freezing it trains a head on random features. Pick a pretrained recipe if you want a frozen backbone.

caveats: Chance for ten classes is 10.0%; the frozen arm is AT it, so its accuracy carries no signal rather than being merely low.
Only 3 rounds with 2 clients and one seed — the FULL arm had not converged and its number is a floor, not a ceiling.
Communication and on-device cost were not measured for this recipe.
This is CIFAR-10 with a small custom CNN; it says nothing about other tasks.
